note: Durable human eyeball verdicts for emitted figure crops (F29) and honest crop-required stubs (F32). Verdict vocabulary: 'accepted' clears the review flag on real crops (kind==crop) on every re-run; 'stub-accepted' records the eyeballed no-croppable-figure decision for crop-required stubs (kind==crop-required) and clears their flag. v0.24.0 (F99) adds the physics eyeball tranche's replacement verdicts: 'recrop' re-renders a wrong-region emitted crop at the eyeballed box (same asset id), and 'rejected' withdraws a wrong-region emitted crop to an honest crop-required stub. F45/F99 manual_crop boxes are the human decision rendered deterministically at CROP_DPI; a box on a different page than the asset's own anchor must carry page_move:true. Chemistry homes keep the F39 legacy keying (bare series for 1C, '<series>:<paper>' for other papers); physics homes are namespaced '4ph1-<series>:<paper>'. Anything not in this ledger keeps the converter's own confidence flag.
